applicant.name: Dr. Anna Kowalska
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Warsaw, Cardiology Research Unit

request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: Scientific research on treatment pathways that requires patient-level longitudinal records; only aggregated results leave the secure environment.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised records of patients with COPD and their medications.
definitions: COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Tiotropium = ATC code starting with R03BB.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per band: patients with COPD, % with active tiotropium, one decimal.
